description: Read the user's running workouts from their Apple Health export (what Apple Fitness and the Apple Watch record; Apple has no web API, so the source is the export.zip the Health app makes) and summarize the last days (90 by default): totals, weekly distance against the four weeks before, average pace, heart rate, cadence, power and climb, the longest run and the fastest runs of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon or longer by average pace, and a list of the latest runs. Use it when the user asks about their running, training load, pace or heart rate. Turn the result into a short answer: how the period went, what changed lately, and anything worth care (a sharp jump in weekly distance). It is informational, not medical advice; for pain, injury or heart concerns, point the user to a doctor. The export comes from `path` (export.zip, export.xml or the unzipped folder in the workspace), else a file in the tool's own folder, else the APPLE_HEALTH_EXPORT_URL share link; the result says which run is newest, so mention it when the export looks out of date (the user re-exports from the Health app to update it). Its output ends with [chart] lines, which the chat draws as charts for the user (distance by week, or by month beyond half a year; pace and heart rate per run): don't repeat those numbers or redraw them with generate_chart unless the user asks for an image file. With export=true it also writes apple_running/runs.csv to the workspace.
author: Hannes Hapke

days.description: The window to summarize, in days up to today.

path.description: Optional: the export in the workspace (export.zip, export.xml, or the apple_health_export folder), relative to /workspace.

unit.description: Optional: km or mi. Defaults to the DISTANCE_UNIT setting, else km.

max_runs.description: How many of the latest runs to list one by one.

refresh.description: Download the export from the share link again even if it looks unchanged.

export.description: Also write the period's runs to apple_running/runs.csv in the workspace.

secrets.name: APPLE_HEALTH_EXPORT_URL
secrets.description: A Dropbox or Google Drive share link (anyone with the link can view) to the export.zip the Health app made
